projects.name: Avon
projects.blurb: Git-based coursework platform for Bristol CS: lecturers upload a skeleton zip, every student gets a provisioned repo, tests run at the deadline. Integrates with Blackboard, Moodle, and Canvas — kills the download-zip / upload-zip / something-breaks loop.
projects.why: Challenging systems work that makes coursework less painful for everyone involved.

projects.name: SEC 10-K AI RAG Pipeline
projects.blurb: Citation-backed RAG over 10 SEC 10-K filings: custom HTML parser, hybrid search, cross-encoder reranking. 95-question eval — recall 63% → 83%. Python, ChromaDB, SQLite, Pandas.
projects.why: Fun, hard retrieval problem with a clear correctness bar.

projects.name: Fault-Tolerant Distributed Game of Life
projects.blurb: Multithreaded Game of Life in Go, distributed over AWS with gRPC. Benchmarked with benchstat; keeps running if a node dies.
projects.why: The first time distributed systems clicked as something you feel in the failure modes.

projects.name: Scotland Yard AI
projects.blurb: Scotland Yard in Java with design patterns and a MiniMax AI. Optimisations took lookahead from 2 moves to 7.
projects.why: A clean puzzle where search quality is the whole game.
